text: When conducting a taxi operation at an unfamiliar and complex aerodrome, flight crews need to be aware of their situation as it relates to other aircraft operation going on around them, as well as other vehicles moving on the aerodrome. It is very important to have and use an aerodrome diagram and to know and use all of the visual aids, such as the signs, markings, and lighting. Question. What means can be useful to the pilot while taxiing at an aerodrome?
